content.passage: The city library will open one study room until 9 pm on weekdays. Weekend hours will remain unchanged. Students can use desks and computers, but book borrowing will stop at 6 pm.
content.question: Which statements are supported by the passage?

options.A: A study room will be available until 9 pm on weekdays.
options.B: Weekend opening hours will be extended.
options.C: Book borrowing ends before study-room access.
options.D: All library services will operate until 9 pm.
